title: PKE skill front matter
description: Front matter of definitions/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. name and description follow the Claude skill format, so Claude Code can load the same file; the other keys are read by the engine's SkillRunner (ADR-007 §8, ADR-013).

name.description: Skill id; must equal the directory name

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 the model's answer must satisfy

tools.description: Engine tools the skill's steps may call on its behalf; any other tool is refused (POLICY)

appliesTo.description: Entity types, source kinds or pipelines the skill is meant for

evalCases.description: Evaluation cases, relative to the skill directory
